programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The banquet is finally here. Its the culmination of months of hard work as the winning four chefs strive to deliver their dishes to an expectant audience of wartime heroes at St Paul's Cathedral, a bastion of British wartime resilience.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three top chefs from Scotland all competition newcomers are out to impress this weeks veteran judge and be crowned Scottish champion.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of Scotlands finest chefs are competing to be crowned champion. All week Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today one chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a very difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood inspired by a local hero honoured by the Queen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. Scotlands two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today it is the starter course of the South West Regional heat. Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Josh is the Michelin star chef proprietor at The Pony and Trap near Bristol.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu today as the three chefs from the South West a region renowned for its seafood - tackle the fish course.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The South West regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort and today they are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UKs leading culinary talents Simon Rogan, heading up Simons The French restaurant at Manchesters Midland hotel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning NW champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. Last year his fish course was shortlisted for the banquet in the national finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting highly creative producing some of the most original and stunning desserts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Its the dessert course that seals the fate of the chefs and the North West Champion is revealed.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael and Adam Bannister. Adam was crowed Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident, he is passionate about seafood. Adam Bannister has created a modern take on the old boil in the bag fish dinners and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Returning Chef, Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an O.B.E, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week in the Welsh heat newcomer Andrew Birch is challenging two returning chefs, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael. It is the dessert course and one chef will go home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional Central champion - Daniel Smith, Andrew Scott and Danny Gill. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Cliffords two star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UKs best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Daniel Smith may be classically trained but hes decided to take a risk adding a cheese custard to his lobster dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up Wellington for royalty. While Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queens Scottish estate, Balmoral.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. Today one competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. And the chefs are pushing themselves.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The Central regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E26 London and South East Starter
programme.desc: Today three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the National Finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E27 London and South East Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E28 London and South East Main
programme.desc: Its the all important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Hes showcasing British Rose veal and celebrating the determination of British producers to bounce back from disaster.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E29 London and South East Dessert
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South Easts most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E30 London and South East Judging
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as Guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award winning food writer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the North East Regional title but hes competing against two young newcomers Tommy Banks and Chris Archer.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and two chefs from the North East, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the main course of the North East Region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. Its a tough and emotional day for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own Great Briton, his late Grandfather.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for the judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Joining them is guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive Head Chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three top chefs from Northern Ireland are competing for a place in the National Finals. There are some varied and exciting starters, as the chefs get creative. And theres real shock and emotion as the veteran chef delivers his scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more competitive as the three chefs from Northern Ireland dish cook their fish courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for an historic score, he could beat his boss a veteran of GBM and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the National Finals of Great British Menu. The chefs will mark each course of the fellow chefs dishes; the average of their scores will be added to the judges scores. There are some shocks and surprises as the chefs opinions differ from the judges.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is day two of Great British Menus National Finals. Today the eight champions will cook their fish courses. Two chefs have reason to be confident after scoring tens from every judge in the heats. Can they deliver a perfect dish second time round?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the National Finals of Great British Menu and main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. It is a nerve wracking day for three of the eight regional champions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the final day of the competition in this years Great British Menu, this is the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth lls Great Britons.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Great British Menus winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. As the banquet is served the chefs show just why they are amongst the best in the country.

programme.desc: Johnny Rush, an Indian wars veteran, returns home to find his land seized by a cattle baron and his love engaged to the enemy. After a brutal fight leaves him unable to use his gun arm, Rush learns to wield a bow and arrow with deadly precision. Determined to reclaim his home and confront betrayal, he fights back against overwhelming odds.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Rancher helps a friend claim a spread he's inherited, only to get involved in his murder.

programme.title: The Reward's Yours... The Man's Mine
programme.desc: A group of killers seek out wanted gunman El Puro for the $10,000 dollar reward.

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: After robbing a Mexican bank, Dad Longworth takes the loot and leaves his partner Rio to be captured but Rio escapes and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: Django... Adios!
programme.desc: Django, a former federal sheriff, is arrested for allegedly stealing a chest full of dollars that was earmarked for the construction of a school and church in Silver City.

programme.title: Hate your Neighbour
programme.desc: Ken wants justice for his brother Bill, who was killed by a notorious gunman named Stevens for a goldmine map. The gunman is arguing with gangster Malone (Horst Frank) about the map. A deadly cat and mouse game between the three men ensues.

programme.title: The Ruthless Four
programme.desc: In Nevada, prospector Sam Cooper and his partner strike gold. But Sam's greedy partner starts shooting at Sam who takes refuge inside the gold mine.

programme.title: Call of the Forest
programme.desc: Bob Brand is looking for a lost gold mine. Storm Cloud makes friends with Bob's son Bobby and to repay Bob for the help he gave the Indians, he gives a map locating the mine to the boy.

programme.title: Viva! Django
programme.desc: Django is on the trail of some renegade outlaws who raped and killed his wife. En route, he rescues a horse thief from an impromptu hanging. He discovers the man knows who committed the murder. The men team up and head west for revenge.

programme.title: A Coffin from Sartana
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal massacre, the legendary hero Sartana is ready to do some investigating. Almost everyone in the tiny town of Indian Creek seems eager to buy up the property left behind by the murder victims, ...

programme.title: The Phantom Gunslinger
programme.desc: Tucca Flats is thrown into chaos when bandits take over and the sheriff flees, leaving clueless Bill in charge. Unarmed and untrained, he faces the gang with strange tools and unexpected allies - finding an unconventional way to fight back.

programme.title: Cry Blood Apache
programme.desc: Gang of sadistic cowboys let nothing stand in their way in their search for gold.

programme.title: 10,000 Dollars for a Massacre
programme.desc: 10,000 Dollars for a Massacre - Django has become a bounty hunter who is asked to chase a villain who has kidnapped a young girl.

programme.title: Twice a Judas
programme.desc: After waking up with amnesia in the desert next to a dead man, Luke Barrett begins piecing together his past. A stranger in black reveals that Luke was hired to kill his own brother, Victor Barrett, a wealthy landowner. As Luke seeks the truth, a deadly confrontation looms, and his memory recovery brings both clarity and danger.

programme.title: The Bounty Killer
programme.desc: A tenderfoot becomes a bounty hunter in the hopes of making a better future for himself and his new love.

programme.title: They Call Him Cemetery
programme.desc: John and George McIntire are a couple of naive brothers who travel to a lawless western town to see their father.

programme.title: Bury Me Not
programme.desc: Two women hide the surprising truth as a sheriff investigates a murder.

programme.title: Santa Fe Passage
programme.desc: A disgraced Indian scout and his partner are hired to escort a wagonload of guns through Indian territory.

programme.title: Bastard, Go and Kill
programme.desc: Chaco, a Mexican on the run from just about everyone, is framed for the killing of a couple of cattlemen.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks.

programme.title: Only the Valiant
programme.desc: Capt. Richard Lance is unjustly held responsible, by his men and girlfriend, for an Indian massacre death of beloved Lt. Holloway. Holloway is killed while escorting a dangerous Indian chief to another fort's prison. The chief escapes. Knowing their fort is in danger of Indian attack, Lance takes a small group of army misfits to an abandoned nearby army fort to defend a mountain pass against the oncoming Indian assault. Their mission is to stall for time until reinforcements from another fort arrive. The men in this small group of malcontents, deserters, psychopaths and cowards all hate Capt. Lance and wish him dead. Much to their chagrin, the men recognize that Lance's survival instincts, military knowledge and leadership are the only chance the group has of staying alive.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Western legends Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday and Billy the Kid are played against each other over the law and the attentions of vivacious country vixen Rio McDonald.

programme.title: Canadian Pacific
programme.desc: A surveyor for the Canadian Pacific Railroad must fight fur trappers who oppose the building of the railroad by stirring up Indian rebellion.

programme.title: Jalisco, Don't Backslide
programme.desc: A man hated by his father and in love with a beautiful woman whose brothers do not approve of the relationship and persecute him.

programme.title: Adiós Gringo
programme.desc: A gunslinger on the run for a murder he didn't commit goes to New Mexico where he hopes to find a person who can exculpate him. While on his way he finds a girl who has been kidnapped and tortured, sets her free and then takes his revenge at gunpoint.

programme.title: Hannie Caulder
programme.desc: After she is raped by the trio of outlaw brothers who murdered her husband, a frontierswoman hires a bounty hunter to instruct her in the use of a gun so she can exact her revenge.

programme.title: Dead Men Don't Make Shadows

Followed by a young gunfighter with his own motive, Lazar forges an uneasy alliance. But as tensions rise, it becomes clear that not everyone is after gold—some seek justice, others revenge.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition; outside, over the fire, on a beautiful sunny day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 The Butter Did It
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: We've all cooked with salt. But what about ON salt. That's right, chef Spencer Watts blows our minds with his seared scallops that are cooked on a Himalayan pink salt block. His next recipe uses a quick cure with Hawaiian black lava salt on swordfish steaks, then tops them with a gorgeous and refreshing grilled fruit salsa. Then, Spencer gets creative with Cured Duck Legs with Scallions, using a salt cure to intensify the flavours of duck leg before it's cooked slow and low, then glazed with maple and soy. After cooking on salt, curing with salt, the only thing left is to cook INSIDE salt - Spencer's Salt Crusted Prime Rib is a game changer, flavourful, bone-in beef that he seasons with a big, bold Dijon mustard, rosemary and horseradish rub before encasing it completely in a classic salt crust and sending it to the grill.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.desc: Matt and the Team "drop in" on a group of thrill seeking skydivers at a Skydiving Jamboree. They let the BBQs rip and grill up three different kinds of wings - smoked, jerked and 'suicide hot'. Then they cool things down with an asparagus cucumber salad.

programme.title: Road Grill

programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Grilled, Roasted & Charred Chicken
programme.desc: Charismatic host Spencer Watts shows us why chicken is best on the grill with four irresistible chicken recipes.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill

programme.title: Watts On the Grill

programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of a good side or dessert! Fun host Spencer Watts grills up the perfect sides and treats for your next barbeque.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Pork was Made for Barbeques
programme.desc: Pork and the grill are good buddies and host Spencer Watts shows us four of his favourite pork recipes that will have you salivating.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Fun and quirky host Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode by showing off his knife skills as he sabres a pineapple to start his instant classic; Grilled Fruit Salad. The pineapple joins a mix of bright summer fruits on the grill, then berries, spicy citrus vinaigrette and savoury feta cheese. Next up, Spencer whips up his Hawaiian Chicken recipe. Spiced with cayenne and Chinese five spice, Spencer stuffs flavourful chicken thighs with pineapple and grills it with a delightful ginger and soy sauce. Every bite is sweet, savoury, and fresh - exactly how summer should taste! Then Spencer shares his top tips for adding smoky flavours to pork using an easy and handy smoke pouch. His Apple Smoked Pork Tenderloin is bathed in a fog of applewood smoke and he then tops it with tart apple-blueberry compote. Cinnamon buns are amazing with a bit of orange peel - but have you ever had them in an orange peel and on the grill? That's right and Spencer shows you how you can make fun and flavourful Orange Peel Cinnamon Buns on the barbecue using indirect heat.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Our fun and occasionally silly chef-host Kimberly Lallouz is taking on a Game Day menu for whatever bowl, cup, or ring your favourite team is bringing home this year! Wear your team colors and cook along as she updates perennial favourites like Chicken Wings (...grilled and smothered in savoury Suya spice!) and Loaded Nachos (with blue corn chips and decadently vegan with her chipotle-cashew 'cheeze!') Next, her Philly-style cheesy flank steak hoagie is a sure crowd pleaser, and for a final play, it's back to the grill with shrimp skewer made Buffalo-style with hot sauce, butter, and creamy avocado ranch dressing. Game on!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy Mascarpone and perfectly balances sweet, smoky, and salty flavours.

programme.desc: While attempting to jump kick the wings of death, Johansson learns about memes, talks about the best movie-set food and tries to avoid spoiling "Avengers: Endgame."

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: Noel Gallagher is a rock 'n' roll legend from Oasis, currently with Noel Gallagher's High Flying Birds.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: Hot Girl Meg takes on the wings of death and discusses her love of anime, the time Cardi B brought a 120-pound albino python to set and the major keys to a great freak anthem.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: Bob Saget became a household name on the classic sitcom Full House as well as a legend on the standup stage.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: Global icon J Balvin eats the spiciest meal of his life with Sean Evans and discusses everything from late nights in Paris with Michael Jordan to how he almost ended up with the stage name Scotch Bonnet.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: The Greatest Band in the World goes wing for wing with Sean Evans. Along they way, the comedic duo discusses everything from Jack's infamous Dorito Burrito to Kanye West to their animated YouTube series.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: Half-Cajun, half-Jewish star Shia LaBeouf battles the brand new "Hot Ones" lineup and discusses everything from wrestling with Tom Hardy to giving Kanye West his "Indiana Jones" hat.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: The Texas Rattlesnake body slams wings and discusses his iconic wrestling career, gives props to The Rock and tells war stories from his years on the road.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: Comedian Gabriel Iglesias is BACK for a very special "Hot Ones" reunion. He is coming off a historic sold-out performance at Dodgers Stadium and has his own sitcom streaming on Netflix.

programme.title: Hot Ones
programme.desc: Academy Award-nominated actor Josh Brolin takes on the wings of death and discusses working with the Coen Brothers, growing up on punk rock and his favorite TV shows of all time.

programme.title: Vetovoiman lait
programme.desc: Tehokkaat avioerolakimiehet Audrey Woods ja Daniel Rafferty ovat nähneet rakkauden menevän pieleen kaikissa pahimmissa skenaarioissaan – kuinka huonot heidän mahdollisuutensa voisivat olla?

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: ”SE”-elokuvan tuottajien CHILD’S PLAY on täysin uusi versio pahasta Chucky-nukesta kertovasta kauhuklassikosta. Chuckyn äänenä kuullaan Mark Hamill. Kun Karen ostaa huippukehittyneen Buddi-nuken syntymäpäivälahjaksi pojalleen Andylle, hän kutsuu tietämättään pahuuden kotiinsa. Andyn täytyy saada aikuiset kuuntelemaan, jotta nukke saadaan pysäytettyä ennen kuin on liian myöhäistä.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: What if
programme.desc: Wallacella ei pyyhi erityisen hyvin tyttöjen keskuudessa: kuivalla huumorintajulla varustettu, opintonsa kesken jättänyt nuorukainen on saanut pettyä kerran toisensa jälkeen. Kun jopa kämppäkaveri Allan löytää täydellisen tyttöystävän, turhautunut Wallace päättää lyödä hanskat tiskiin ja pistää rakkauselämänsä jäähylle. Silloin hän törmää Chantryyn, animaattoriin joka asuu yhdessä pitkäaikaisen poikaystävänsä kanssa. Varatusta tytöstä tulee nopeasti Wallacen läheisin ystävä, jonka kanssa voi puhua mistä vain aina lempielokuvista epäonnistuneisiin joululahjoihin. Viestiliikenteen kiivastuessa ja kemian tiivistyessä molemmat joutuvat pohtimaan, voiko paras ystävä ollakin elämän suuri rakkaus.

programme.title: Match Point
programme.desc: Chris Wilton on nuori ja komea mutta rahaton tennisvalmentaja, joka sotkeutuu rikkaan perheen kuvioihin ryhdyttyään perheen tyttären valmentajaksi. Rakkaussuhteet kahden eri naisen kanssa pakottavat hänet julmaan rikokseen. Intohimoa, kiusauksia ja mielettömyyttä yläluokan Lontoossa.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: Rakkaus voittaa kaiken. Jopa vastustamattoman pakon syödä kumppaninsa aivokudosta! Lähitulevaisuudessa maapallolla asuu yhtä paljon ihmisiä syöviä zombeja kuin myös zombeja vastaan taistelevia ihmisiä. Hetken mielijohteesta nuori zombi R pelastaa toisten zombien hyökkäykseltä Julien, jonka suonissa veri virtaa kovaa. Heidän ystävyytensä uhkaa sen hetkistä maailmanjärjestystä! Julien pitää vain pysyä hengissä ja R:n pitää pysyä kuolleena tarpeeksi kauan.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: THEN CAME YOU kertoo kuolemansairaasta teinistä Skyesta (Maisie Williams) ja luulosairaasta 19-vuotiaasta Calvinista (Asa Butterfield), joka pelkää omaa varjoaankin. Calvin auttaa Skyeta toteuttamaan omintakeisia haaveitaan asioista, joita hän haluaa tehdä vielä ennen kuolemaansa. Samalla Calvin oppii myös kohtaamaan ja voittamaan omat pelkonsa – ja uskaltaa rakastua kauniiseen, mutta etäiseen Izzyyn (Nina Dobrev).

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Kun neljä ulkopuolista näki sen, minkä isot pankit, media ja valtionhallinto kielsivät - maailmantalouden romahtamisen - he saivat ajatuksen isosta shorttauksesta. Rohkea sijoittaminen johtaa heidät pankkialan pimeälle puolelle, jossa kaikki on kyseenalaistettava. Adam Mckayn (Anchorman, Step Brothers) ohjaama elokuva perustuu tositarinaan ja Michael Lewisin menestyskirjaan (The Blind Side, Moneyball). Elokuvaa tähdittävät Christian Bale, Steve Carell, Ryan Gosling ja Brad Pitt.

programme.title: A Walk to Remember
programme.desc: Paha poika Landon valitaan koulunäytelmään lukutoukka Jamien vastanäyttelijäksi. Heidän välilleen puhkeaa romanssi, mutta tragedia uhkaa repiä heidät erilleen.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa. Perintönsä pelannut Ylönen tarjoaa klubilaisille mystisen aterian, jonka raaka-ainetta kukaan ei arvaa. Ateria aiheuttaa kuitenkin sellaisen vaikutuksen, että he kaikki haluavat sitä uudestaan ja uudestaan. Ylönen saa paljon enemmän kuin osasi toivoakaan.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: Yritysvakoilun hämärässä valtakunnassa kyllästynyt jokamies kompastuu petoksen verkkoon ja hänestä tulee tietämätön vakooja. Kun hän navigoi petoksessa ja petoksessa, hän tekee yhteistyötä viettelevän arvoituksen kanssa paljastaakseen järkyttäviä totuuksia ja saadakseen takaisin identiteettinsä.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Oscar ja Golden Globe palkittu Morgan Freeman esittää elokuvatähteä, joka suunnittelee valkokankaalle paluuta neljän vuoden poissaolon jälkeen. Harkitessaan roolia supermarketin päällikkönä, hän käy pienessä latino-marketissa Los Angelesin laitamilla. Siellä hän tapaa kipakan kassaneidin, Scarletin (Paz Vega, Spanglish – käännöskukkasia, Puhu hänelle). Huomatessaan olevansa kaukana kotoaan, ilman puhelinta taikka ajoneuvoa, elokuvatähti hyväksyy Scarletin tarjouksen kyydistä takaisin ”sivilisaatioon”. Matkan varrella tämä ulkoisesti niin erilainen pari löytää yhteisen sävelen, joka pysyvästi muuttaa heidän suhtautumistaan elämään.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: Cold War on intohimoinen rakkaustarina miehestä ja naisesta, Wiktorista ja Zulasta, jotka tapaavat toisensa sotienjälkeisen Puolan raunioissa. Nämä kaksi täysin erilaisen taustan ja mielenlaadun omaavaa ihmistä ovat toistensa täydelliset vastakohdat, ja silti auttamattomasti tuomittuja kuulumaan toisilleen. 1950-luvun kylmän sodan aikaiseen Puolaan, Berliiniin, Jugoslaviaan ja Pariisiin sijoittuvassa tarinassa pariskunnan erottavat toisistaan poliittiset käänteet, tuliset luonteet ja onnettomat kohtalon oikut - mahdoton rakkaustarina mahdottomana aikana.

programme.title: Imaginary Heroes
programme.desc: Nokkela, herkullisen ivallinen tarina perheestä, jonka kulissit alkavat sortua vakavan tragedian seurauksena. Perheen nuorin poika hautoo kipeää salaisuutta kuin pahan unen vankina. Äiti laukoo sarkastisia ajatuksia ja hukuttaa tuskansa pulloon ja naapurin yksinhuoltajaan. Katkeransuolaista huumoria, lämpöä, rakkautta ja kaikkea siltä väliltä.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: Mary Shelley on kertomus Mary Wollstonecraft Godwinista – maailmankuulun goottilaisen romaanin "Frankensteinin" kirjoittajasta – ja hänen raivokkaasta ja myrskyisästä suhteestaan tunnettuun romanttiseen runoilijaan Percy Bysshe Shelleyyn. Mary ja Percy julistavat rakastavansa toisiaan, ja Maryn perheen kauhuksi pari päättää karata yhdessä. Maryn siskopuoli Claire lähtee Maryn mukaan. Pariskunnan välien kiristyessä lordi Byronin luona Genevenjärvellä syntyy ajatus Frankensteinista, kun seurue päättää kilpailla keskenään parhaan kauhutarinan kirjoittamisessa.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Ray Keene (John Cusack), isä, joka haluaa lunastaa paikkansa poikansa (Jamie Anderson) silmissä, yrittää saada maailmanluokan salamurhaajan Cardenin (Morgan Freeman) oikeuden eteen. Samaan aikaan hänen on suojeltava poikaansa ja väisteltävä salamurhaajan tiimiä, joka metsästää heitä metodisesti erämaassa.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: The Big Short

programme.desc: Wallacella ei pyyhi erityisen hyvin tyttöjen keskuudessa: kuivalla huumorintajulla varustettu, opintonsa kesken jättänyt nuorukainen on saanut pettyä kerran toisensa jälkeen. Viestiliikenteen kiivastuessa ja kemian tiivistyessä molemmat joutuvat pohtimaan, voiko paras ystävä ollakin elämän suuri rakkaus.

programme.title: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
programme.desc: Vuosi on 1985. Pastellivärien, puutelihiusten ja otsanauhojen aikakautena nuori Janey uneksii tanssijan urasta. Koulua hän on ehtinyt vaihtaa jo 11 kertaa, ja hän tietää että ne eivät muutu miksikään. Hänen uusimmassa koulussaan on tosin jotain erikoista. Ei se että se sijaitsee Chicagossa, vaan se että siellä tehdään suosittua nuoriso-ohjelmaa nimeltä Dance TV. Täällä Janey tapaa tanssifriikki Lynnen joka houkuttelee hänet koetanssiin, ja menestyksen ovet alkavat avautua.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen (Tulitikkutehtaan tyttö ja Le Havre) palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla. Elokuvan miespääosassa nähdään Markku Peltola (Jadesoturi ja Kauas pilvet karkaavat).

programme.title: A Walk to Remember
programme.desc: Paha poika Landon valitaan koulunäytelmään lukutoukka Jamien vastanäyttelijäksi. Heidän välilleen puhkeaa romanssi, mutta tragedia uhkaa repiä heidät erilleen.

programme.title: Teen Spirit
programme.desc: Rikkinäisessä perheessä kasvanut 17-vuotias Violet (Fanning) unelmoi pop-tähteydestä ja paosta pienestä englantilaisesta kotikylästään. Toivoa hänelle tuo kansallinen laulukilpailu Teen Spirit ja epätavallinen mentori, joka opettaa häntä laulamaan sydämestään. Tie menestykseen on kuitenkin täynnä vaaroja ja houkutuksia. Violetin on voitettava epävarmuutensa uskaltaakseen olla oma itsensä ja päästäkseen lopulta loistamaan.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa! Jo aamiainen ja koulumaksujen hoitaminen ovat rankkoja tehtäviä, mutta kun yksi lapsista suututtaa venäläisen terroristin, viikonloppu saa aivan uudenlaisen käänteen.Jackie Chaniin ei väsy koskaan eikä Jackie Chan ole koskaan liian vanha näyttämään taistelulajiosaamistaan tai tekemään vaarallisia stuntteja, sillä jälleen kerran hänellä on vastassaan vihollisia: pieniä lapsukaisia!

programme.title: A Dangerous Method
programme.desc: Todellisiin tapahtumiin perustuva elokuva psykoanalyysin synnystä kertoo psykiatri Carl Jungin, hänen mentorinsa Sigmund Freudin ja kauniin mutta mieleltään järkkyneen Sabina Spielreinin myrskyisästä suhteesta. Kunnianhimoinen tohtori Carl Jung (Michael Fassbender) ottaa potilaakseen epätasapainoisen mutta kauniin Sabina Spielreinin (Keira Knightley). Jung tarttuu mahdottomaan haasteeseen aseenaan kuuluisan Sigmund Freudin (Viggo Mortensen) kumouksellinen menetelmä. Kumpikin mies joutuu Sabinan lumoihin. Zürichiin ja Wieniin ennen ensimmäistä maailmansotaa sijoittuva tarina sukeltaa syvälle ihmismielen ja seksuaalisuuden syövereihin.

programme.title: The Mothman Prophecies
programme.desc: Journalisti John Klein ja hänen vaimonsa Mary joutuvat kohtalokkaaseen onnettomuuteen. Vaimon kuoleman jälkeen Johnin pakkomielteeksi muodostuvat Maryn sairaalassa tekemät luonnokset, jotka kuvaavat tummaa, siivekästä hahmoa. Pari vuotta myöhemmin eräällä juttumatkallaan John ajaa selittämättömällä tavalla muutamassa tunnissa satoja maileja ja joutuu Point Pleasantin pikkukaupunkiin. Poliisi Connie Parker kertoo seudulla sattuneista havainnoista: yöperhosmainen punasilmäinen olio on ilmestynyt useille paikkakuntalaisille...

programme.title: Vetovoiman lait
programme.desc: Tehokkaat avioerolakimiehet Audrey Woods ja Daniel Rafferty ovat nähneet rakkauden menevän pieleen kaikissa pahimmissa skenaarioissaan – kuinka huonot heidän mahdollisuutensa voisivat olla?

programme.title: Unelmien Naapuri
programme.desc: Teräväpiirtokuvalla ja bonusmateriaaleilla varustettu Emile Hirschin, Elisha Cuthbertin ja Timothy Olyphantin tähdittämä riehakas komedia on kuumempi kuin koskaan! High Schoolista juuri valmistuva luokan priimus, Matthew Kidman haluaa saada koulun päätökseen ilman teinihörhöilyjen aiheuttamia ongelmia. Valitettavasti, ongelma muuttaa naapuriin, eikä Matthew pysty vastustamaan kiusausta.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: Cold War on intohimoinen rakkaustarina miehestä ja naisesta, Wiktorista ja Zulasta, jotka tapaavat toisensa sotienjälkeisen Puolan raunioissa. Nämä kaksi täysin erilaisen taustan ja mielenlaadun omaavaa ihmistä ovat toistensa täydelliset vastakohdat, ja silti auttamattomasti tuomittuja kuulumaan toisilleen. 1950-luvun kylmän sodan aikaiseen Puolaan, Berliiniin, Jugoslaviaan ja Pariisiin sijoittuvassa tarinassa pariskunnan erottavat toisistaan poliittiset käänteet, tuliset luonteet ja onnettomat kohtalon oikut - mahdoton rakkaustarina mahdottomana aikana.

programme.title: This is England
programme.desc: Elokuva sijoittuu 1980-luvun Englantiin, jossa Falklandin sotaan lähetetään jatkuvasti lisää sotilaita ja kansallismieliset saavat jalansijaa työväenluokkaisten työttömien keskuudessa. Skan ja Oi-punkin kannattajat jakautuvat musiikin ystäviin ja skineihin. Tämän kaiken keskellä 12-vuotias Shaun löytää skinijengin kanssa yhteisen sävelen.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Newyorkilainen työhullu kustannustoimittaja Jackie (Helen Hunt) seuraa poikaansa (Brenton Thwaites) Los Angelesiin. Poika haluaa jättää opiskelut sikseen ja elää unelmaansa Kaliforniassa, missä myös äidillä on pian edessään tyrskyjä ja kuohuja. Lämminhenkisessä komediassa Jackie tutustuu limusiinikuskiinsa (David Zayas), löytää seksin ilot nuoren surffauksen opettajan (Luke Wilson) kanssa ja tutustuu uudestaan poikaansa, itseensä ja maailmaan.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT

programme.desc: Rookie pilot Jeff nearly runs off the runway. Prefkar learns to play hockey but drops the ball at Buffalo and Joe goes on a date with a real dog.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Mikey decides to get Buffalo involved in a D-Day paratrooper jump to commemorate the 70th anniversary of D-Day.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot Scott faces his worst nightmare when a faltering Curtiss C-46 Commando engine and low fog force a scary landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Christmas is just around the corner, but Buffalo's crucial food and mail runs come to a halt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Mechanic Cory races against the clock to turn two short-haul waterbombers into transatlantic aircraft for the epic journey to Turkey.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: A charter flight falls through the cracks after the McBryans attend a wild family wedding, and an irate Joe pulls captain Justin from the Turkey test flights to do the job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: A furious Joe fights against a federal suspension that will prevent him from carrying passengers for the first time in 20 years.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: AJ and Candace get married in the Ice Castle. A frustrated Chuck tries to get the Electra to pay her way. A flummoxed Mikey tries to bake a cake for Joe's birthday.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: The Turkey crew makes the critical jump over the North Atlantic. But en route to Portugal, one crew is forced to turn back.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: After thousands of hours of painstaking preparation and dangerous flying, a terrible accident devastates the waterbomber crew in Turkey - and everyone at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: When her husband quits after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. Will she stay at Buffalo - or will she go?

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: After her husband's acrimonious departure from Buffalo, Kelly has a confrontation that decides whether she, too, will quit.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: When a deadly fire destroys a northern outpost a week before Christmas, Buffalo puts everything aside to come to the rescue.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: The curse of -40 hits Buffalo pilots Devan and Scott on a food mail flight up the Mackenzie Valley when a mysterious rise in oil pressure threatens to destroy one of the C-46's engines.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Mikey goes on a treasure hunt to Venezuela for a rare CL-215 waterbomber.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: A vital ferry link is down, so Buffalo mounts an all-out campaign to airlift 100,000lbs of essential goods across the Mackenzie River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: A multi-stop mission to the Far North has Devan, Scott and Adam facing a series of white- knuckle obstacles.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Young pilots AJ and Andrew get the chance of a lifetime to fly the magnificent DC-3 specially equipped with skis to land on frozen strips.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Buffalo scores the charter of a lifetime when they're asked to transport the Stanley Cup on a tour of the North.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: When thunderstorms and a shaking engine threaten a DC-3 charter to Whitehorse, Joe pulls out all the stops to get the passengers to their destination.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: While training waterbomber captains for the upcoming fire-fighting season, Chief Pilot Arnie makes a surprising decision.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Joe hires Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey; a DC-3 delivery mission goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Buffalo gets into the stunt flying business when veteran pilot Arnie flies the DC-4 for the re- enactment scene of a famous WWII bombing raid.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Critical of the many stops and starts in the Electra program, and frustrated with the constant drama at Buffalo, Chuck quits.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: When a ferry breakdown causes a gasoline shortage in Yellowknife, new manager Duane begs Chuck to return and prepare the Electra for a fuel haul.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Duane lands a huge contract for the Electra and puts enormous pressure on mechanic Adam to prep the plane without the help of his mentor Chuck.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: The Electra flies to Alert, the northernmost settlement on Earth, forcing Adam and new senior manager Duane to work things out.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Sparks fly when Joe discovers Gord has taken a job with a rival airline after completing expensive training on one of the Buffalo planes.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Duane's decision to leave the Electra crew unsupervised while he spends time at home jeopardizes the completion of a major contract, and could cost him his job.

programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine.

programme.desc: Engine troubles on the C-46 during the valley run force Devan to shut down an engine.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: Weighed down by the responsibility of training a new rampie, and struggling to get out of Joe's doghouse, DC-3 co-pilot Tyler gets a once in a lifetime opportunity to stunt fly in his Cessna 150 for a visiting film crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: After taking command of an intense airlift, and dealing with the ugliest Electra load he's ever seen, Scott takes a scary fall on the icy tarmac.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT
programme.desc: A week before Christmas, Buffalo agrees to lend a hand to an RCMP initiative to fly toys to isolated communities in the north.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT

programme.desc: Justin and Cory attempt to place a Canadair CL-215 aircraft onto a cargo ship for delivery to a Korean company.

programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT

programme.desc: Justin and Cory are stranded in Croatia while trying to complete the delivery of two CL-215 water bombers to Turkey.

programme.desc: Joe races a quirky antique snowmobile - with an airplane engine and no brakes. The water bomber crew struggles to get two planes out of Turkey. Cocky rampie Chris Staples tries to prove himself in the C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT

programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.desc: Mikey trains for High Arctic survival with the Canadian Rangers. The Air Force invades Chuck's hangar. Joe faces tough competition at a California plane auction.
